title: Frequently Asked Questions

questions.question: Can the services be customized?
questions.answer: Yes. Every event is unique, and all our services can be tailored to your vision, theme, and desired experience.

questions.question: Can I combine multiple services?
questions.answer: Absolutely. We invite you to explore our Packages section to see examples of how different services can be combined to create a personalized experience.

questions.question: What types of dance shows do you offer?
questions.answer: We offer a variety of styles, including ballet, contemporary, salsa, tango, themed shows, and custom choreographies for your event.

questions.question: Do you travel outside Montreal?
questions.answer: Yes. We are available for events across Quebec, Ontario, and other destinations upon request.

questions.question: How can I request a quote?
questions.answer: Simply fill out our contact form or write to us directly via WhatsApp. We’ll be happy to discuss your event and prepare a personalized proposal.
